Surging Republican presidential hopeful Dr. Ben Carson reiterated his stance against all, or nearly all, abortions on Sunday and went so far as to compare the women who get them to slave owners.
The renowned neurosurgeon, who's suddenly found himself ahead of even Donald Trump in recent Iowa polls, made the controversial comparison during an appearance on NBC's Meet the Press.
Carson said he remains staunchly opposed to Roe V.

Wade, which he would 'love' to see overturned, though he said he would consider keeping abortions legal for the "extraordinarily rare situation" in which a woman's life depends on terminating a pregnancy.
This is not the first time Carson has courted controversy by comparing a controversial issue with slavery.
